remarks: One level open concept garden style apt with 2 bed and 2 full bath, fully renovated with large double slider doors to top level private deck open to red oak canopy. Granite countertops and white shaker cabinets, fully tiled and modern bathrooms, one with shower and other with bathtub. Full sized washer and dryer for laundry in closet. Plenty of bedroom closet space, and storage unit in carport lower level. Assigned carport with plenty of off street unassigned parking. Located conveniently near Whole Foods, retail shopping, restaurants, UConn, train and parks. In-ground pool and clubhouse for association use.
